description: Production knowledge base of the FoodFlow claims assistant: documents 01-10. Documents 11-15 stay in the source directory as experimental material and are excluded on purpose. source_sha256 and expected are derived values: change them only with `build-chunks --corpus-manifest configs/corpus/foodflow_production_v1.json --refresh-manifest` and review the diff.
